description: Turn any employee list into an interactive, multilevel organization chart, right inside Power BI. Add an Employee ID and a Manager ID column from your HR data (a Microsoft SharePoint list, Excel, Dataverse or a database) and every level of the organization builds itself. No hierarchy tables or DAX are needed. Features - Unlimited levels, built from Employee ID → Manager ID - Expand and collapse any team; collapsed managers show their team size - Search by name, title or department. The chart opens the branch, centers and highlights the person - Expand all, Collapse and Fit buttons, plus zoom and pan - Cards with photo or initials, name, title and department, colored by department - Click a person to cross-filter your report; Ctrl-click to select several - Tooltips with direct reports, total organization size and any extra fields you add - Top-to-bottom or left-to-right layout; card, color and spacing options in the Format pane - Flags data problems (missing managers, duplicate IDs, reporting loops) instead of breaking - Keyboard navigation and high-contrast support - Handles up to 30,000 people Privacy The visual makes no network requests and collects no data. Photos are drawn only from images embedded in your data. Setup guide Step-by-step instructions for creating the employee list in SharePoint, a ready-made Power Query and a CSV template are at…
